about: Hotbar skills (keys 1-4). Each kind is one effect the game knows how to run (see systems.json, row skill-kinds). Chain skills (AION style) have chainFrom set: when that skill lands, the chain skill lights up in the same hotbar slot for a few seconds.

columns.name: shown name
columns.kind: strike | shot | nova | blast | dot | stun | dash | heal | buff | shield | aura | leap | pull | drain | pet | stealth | trap | blink | guard | haste | regen | mana | salvation | delayed (marks the ground, then detonates) | zone (holy ground: heals you, burns Locust)
columns.rankLevels: levels where it gains a rank (rank 1 at unlock)
columns.range: metres to target or cone length (0 = self)
columns.radius: metres of the area or cone half-width (0 = single target)
columns.duration: seconds for dot, stun, buff, shield, aura (0 = instant)
columns.chainFrom: skill that opens this chain skill in the same slot (none = a hotbar skill)
columns.castTime: seconds of casting before it goes off (0 = instant); moving cancels a cast
columns.cc: crowd control on what it hits: none | stun | knockback | knockdown | airborne | root | slow | silence (no special attacks) | disarm (no attacks) | taunt (they turn on you and hit softer)
columns.element: physical | fire | ice | lightning | holy | shadow | wind | earth | spirit | poison | arcane: the look of the skill and how Locust take it (armour cuts physical; each Locust has a weakness and a resistance)
